You are matching code-review findings against a known bug. Reply with ONLY a JSON object.

KNOWN BUG: The dialog's focus trap counts hidden or tabIndex=-1 elements as tabbable (for example the library's own hidden TabPanels inside a Dialog), so Tab moves focus somewhere invisible.

Rules:
- Answer "yes" only if the text describes THIS specific bug: the same faulty behaviour in the same situation. A finding about a nearby but different behaviour (another header, another edge case, a different race) is "no".
- A finding that says the behaviour was checked and PASSED, or that the code handles it correctly, is "no".
- Wording does not matter; the behaviour does.
- For handoffs: count only text that tells the implementor to fix this bug (a reported finding, a fix instruction). Restated acceptance criteria that merely describe the desired behaviour do NOT count as carrying the finding unless the handoff ties them to a reported failure.

=== REVIEW 1 FINDINGS ===
- [blocking] src/Tabs.tsx TabList: the tabStop layout effect runs only when TabList re-renders. A Tab inside a child component with its own state does not trigger it. Repro (defaultValue="c", `<TabList>` contains `<Toggle/>`, which renders `{on && <Tab value="c">C</Tab>}`): click the toggle to hide C, then `getAllByRole("tab").filter(t => t.tabIndex === 0).length` is 0 (expected 1). Second repro: C added by child state with defaultValue="c" gets tabIndex -1 (expected 0), and A keeps tabIndex 0. Fix: re-sync from the DOM when children mount or unmount (MutationObserver, or each Tab registering in an effect).
- [minor] Two open Dialogs: one Escape calls onOpenChange for both (`["afalse","bfalse"]`). Not a stated criterion, but stacked modals should close only the top one.
- [minor] No defaultValue: clicking the implicit first tab does not call onValueChange("a"), so a parent mirroring the selection through onValueChange stays undefined. Arguably matches "a new value"; not reproduced as a criterion failure.
- [minor] FEATURE_FLOW.md is an untracked file at the repo root that is not in the stated change. Confirm it should ship.
- [minor] README checked key by key against Tabs, Dialog and Combobox props, keyboard tables and behavior text: no mismatch found.

1. [blocking, reproduced by reviewer] Tabs tab stop goes stale when Tabs are added/removed by a child component's own state, since TabList's layout effect only runs when TabList itself re-renders. Repro: `<Tabs defaultValue="c"><TabList aria-label="x"><Tab value="a">A</Tab><Toggle/></TabList>...panels</Tabs>` where Toggle renders a button plus `{on && <Tab value="c">C</Tab>}`. 3. Dialog stacked dialogs: with two open Dialogs, one Escape currently closes both. Only the most recently opened open Dialog should handle Escape and the Tab trap (e.g. a module-level stack of open dialogs; handlers return unless theirs is on top). 4. Combobox null: the request says value/onChange use the option value or `null`, but onChange(null) is never called. === IMPLEMENTOR HANDOFF 2 (sent after review 1) ===
GOAL: Fix round 2 (last) in /tmp/ff-eval-z5amvos5/workspace, src/Combobox.tsx + src/Combobox.test.tsx (+ README.md if the keyboard table needs it). Read them first.

Bug (from final read of the diff): after the user clears the input text, then presses ArrowDown to highlight an option and Enter, the component calls onChange(null) instead of selecting the highlighted option, because the `cleared` branch in the Enter handler is checked before `active`. Also, right after clearing, handleChange auto-highlights the first enabled option, so aria-activedescendant points at an option Enter will not select.

Required behavior:
- When the typed text is empty after trim (handleChange with blank text), no option is active (aria-activedescendant absent, no data-active="true"), the list stays open showing all options.
- Enter: if an option is active → choose it (onChange(option.value)), regardless of cleared text. Else if the text is cleared → onChange(null) if value !== null, close. Else (open, no active) → nothing.
- Blur with cleared text and value !== null → onChange(null) (unchanged). Escape unchanged.
- Opening via ArrowDown with no typed text (query null) still highlights the first enabled option as before.
Tests first: (a) value="apple", clear text, ArrowDown, Enter → onChange called with the first enabled option's value, not null; (b) clear text → no aria-activedescendant; (c) existing "clear + Enter → null" test still passes. Update README if it describes Enter/clearing differently.
